quest.title: Origin of the Sequence
quest.description: You discover a strangely familiar tower...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: Vital signs detected. Invoking identification sequence: <color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>. Commencing kernel security check...

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: Kernel security check: <color=#FF5E41FF>FAILED</color>. Central module damaged or missing. Please contact Nin-Kiggia for maintenance. Initiating backup safety mode...

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: My apologies. The identification sequence is currently unable to verify the visitor. Consequently, I cannot address you by your proper title. Commencing universal greeting playback.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Ia-I{RUBY#[S]No. 59}limmu Storage Array. This array is primarily used to regulate the operation of the Engraving and to store various research resources.

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: <color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>: Critical component failure has resulted in service dependency anomalies. Main functions are currently unavailable. Please execute a self-diagnostic command to restore critical data nodes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon didn't really get what it was saying, but it sounds like we just need to follow the instructions on the screen to fix this thing, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And if this place is for "storing resources," that just means it's a "storehouse"! Paimon bets there are all kinds of super-amazing treasures nearby! Come on, let's give it a shot!

talks.objective: Follow the prompts to repair the data nodes
Investigate the Secret Source Dragon Idol

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: Self-diagnostic: Repair complete. Thank you for your help. Deactivating lockdown...

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Terminal
dialogues.text: <color=#FF5E41FF>ERROR</color>: Primary energy system not connected. Please contact Nin-Kiggia for assistance, or provide an auxiliary power source.
